title: Remove governance micro-gating while preserving fail-closed drift controls

acceptance.text: The real failure sequence is reproduced in disposable synthetic governance fixtures and mapped to root causes.
Authorized task progress is continuous across scoped artifacts, tests, receipts, descendant commits, expiry, recovery, and release readiness.
Expired permit history is never semantically active, while accepted task lineage advances without manual rebaseline.
All required external-drift, CAS, scope, traversal, owner, merge, and scientific-data safety controls still fail closed.
The execution model, G0/G1/G2 boundaries, and named acceptance markers are documented and validated.
Only governance manager/tests/docs changes are integrated after fresh destination owner-work checks and post-integration validation.

risks: Do not weaken owner-drift, scope, CAS, merge, or scientific-data mutation safeguards.
Existing CLOSED governance and scientific records are historical fixtures and remain immutable.
non_actions: Do not modify active S1 or Temporal-v2 worktrees, data, model code, training outputs, or scientific authorities.
Do not use GPU, remote compute, training, or scientific data in this repair.
Do not add wildcard bypasses, global fingerprint disablement, or global scope disablement.
Do not reset, clean, stash, or overwrite owner work.

skills.purpose: Map state-machine conflations and preserve hard safety boundaries.
Operate the repair through the governed task, permit, evidence, and closeout lifecycle.
Reconcile state and preserve unrelated owner work at integration and closeout.
Keep the manager repair small, reversible, and covered by focused synthetic tests.

steps.summary: Reproduce the historical failure sequence and persist the root-cause map before the behavioral fix.
Implement progression-aware accepted lineage, safe task-owned scope, and non-zombie permit lifecycle semantics.
Run the full synthetic scientific-task acceptance matrix and document the execution model and named markers.
Freeze the governance release candidate, integrate only approved governance paths, and validate the destination.
